text.「素材の寿命＝接着剤の寿命」にならない、メンテナンス可能な素材を選んでいます。: We choose materials that can be maintained — materials whose life is not simply the life of the adhesive holding them together.
text.昔から使われてきて、素材の良さがよく理解され、今後も永く使われていく建材を選んで: We choose building materials that have been used for generations, whose qualities are well understood, and which will go on being used for a long time yet.
text.ビニールやプラスチックといった化学物質や、化学接着剤を使用した化学建材ではなく、: Rather than synthetic materials such as vinyl and plastic, or products bonded with synthetic adhesives, we choose building materials made from natural things that are kind to the body.
text.一般的なビニールクロスや合板フローリングといった部屋に、お気に入りの家具を合わせ: Have you ever put a favourite piece of furniture into a room finished in ordinary vinyl wallcovering and plywood flooring, and felt that something did not quite sit right?
text.私共は、質感の合う建材を選び、良い家具がより活かされるよう配慮します。: We choose materials whose texture agrees with the furniture, so that good pieces are shown at their best.
text.壁と天井には漆喰をご提案しています。私共の取り扱う漆喰は自然素材100％、日本で: For walls and ceilings we propose shikkui lime plaster. The plaster we work with is 100% natural. Lime plaster has been used in Japan for centuries, and it is excellent for fire resistance, for regulating humidity, and for safety.
text.熟練職人の手により、なめらかでいて、味のある風合いに仕上げられた漆喰の壁はビニー: Laid by a skilled plasterer, smooth and yet full of character, a lime plaster wall does what vinyl wallcovering cannot: it takes the shadows of the lighting beautifully.
text.住まいの中には木製の建具や巾木など、ペイントを使用する箇所が少なからずあります。: There are a fair number of places in a home that are painted — timber joinery, skirtings and so on. Paints come in many kinds, oil-based and water-based, and some cannot be used without thinning with solvent or lacquer. For paint used inside a home, we use paint free of the volatile organic compounds (VOCs) that are harmful to people.
text.私共では、長い歴史を持つイギリスのFARROW&BALLのペイントをお薦めしてい: We recommend Farrow & Ball of England, a paint with a long history. It uses natural pigments, has no smell, comes in a wide range of colours, and has been loved for generations.
text.フローリングには一般的に使用されている木目調のプリントがされた合板（化学接着剤で: Flooring ranges from the common printed wood-grain plywood — wood waste bound with synthetic adhesive — to boards cut from a single piece of solid timber. The first has a glossy surface, and some are coated to resist scratching. They are easy to look after, but they do not last.
text.無垢材のフローリングは、季節によって多少の伸び縮みがありますが、味わい深く、足触: Solid timber flooring moves a little with the seasons, but it has depth of character and it is soft underfoot. And because the board is around 15 mm thick, a floor marked by years of use can be sanded back and brought up clean again.
text.私共では、無垢材のフローリングを接着剤を使わずに一枚一枚ビスで固定しています。天: We lay solid timber flooring board by board, screw-fixed, with no adhesive, and finish it in natural oil. With time the oils in the timber itself deepen the colour and the sheen.
text.カーペットは一般的に、アクリルやナイロンなど、化学繊維のものが多く見られますが、: Most carpet is synthetic — acrylic, nylon. We propose carpet in natural fibres such as wool and linen, which are warm in winter and cool in summer.
text.また、通常使用される接着剤を使わずに施工しています。: We lay it without the adhesive normally used.

description: Lime plaster, solid timber flooring, natural-fibre carpet and VOC-free paint: how Timeless Living chooses materials that can be maintained rather than replaced.
